messages.subject: blavaan 0.3-9 is released
parts:
blavaan 0.3-9 is now on CRAN. It fixes a number of bugs, and sampling of lvs (save.lvs=TRUE) is significantly improved for target="stan".

Some further detail is at: http://faculty.missouri.edu/~merklee/blavaan/version.html
